name: Share Access Panel
description: A share panel where typed emails become validated chips, roles sit in a compact menu, removals offer Undo, and link access steps from restricted to public.

props.name: docTitle
props.description: The thing being shared, in the heading.

props.name: members
props.description: People with access. The owner can’t be changed; pending invites get a dashed avatar.

props.name: orgDomain
props.description: Addresses on this domain are your organisation; anyone else gets a Guest tag.

props.name: orgName
props.description: Used in the “Anyone at …” link level.

props.name: linkAccess
props.description: Optional. Drive the general access level from outside; pair with onLinkAccessChange.

props.name: linkRole
props.description: What people arriving by link can do.

props.name: link
props.description: Written to the clipboard by Copy link.

props.name: undoMs
props.description: How long Undo stays after removing someone.

props.name: onInvite
props.description: Called with the valid addresses when Invite is pressed. Invalid chips stay behind.

props.name: onRemove
props.description: Called when someone is removed (Undo puts them back).

props.name: onRoleChange
props.description: Called when a member’s role changes.

props.name: onLinkAccessChange
props.description: Called when the general access level changes.

props.name: accent
props.description: The one accent: the Invite button, selected checks and the Copied tick. Button text flips black or white to stay readable.
